name: a request types on with one command glowing inline
looks: A plain input box sits alone in the dark. A short request types on character by character, and partway through, one phrase inside the sentence -- a named command -- lights up in a glowing accent-coloured pill inline with the rest of the typed text, as the request completes with a blinking cursor.
build: DOM input panel, text revealed per character with a blinking cursor at a steady rate; the command token is wrapped in its own span that gains a glow (box-shadow, accent colour) the instant it's typed, staying lit as the rest of the sentence continues typing around it.
sound: A soft mechanical key tick per character, a slightly brighter tick as the glowing command token lands.
prompt: Type a short request into a plain input box character by character, and the instant a named command appears inside the sentence, let just that phrase light up in a glowing pill while the rest of the sentence keeps typing around it in plain text -- the command should read as the one 'live' word in an otherwise ordinary instruction.
